provenance: Original synthetic n8n troubleshooting cases authored for this project. No scraped workflow exports, credentials, customer data, or copied source code.
task: Diagnose an n8n workflow error and propose a minimal JSON Patch operation, or abstain when unsafe/unsupported.
split_policy: Separately authored cases; no identifier substitution or cross-split prompt reuse.
limitations: The benchmark measures output schema, diagnosis, gold patch match, patch applicability to supplied synthetic workflow fixtures, and safe abstention. Patch applicability is not proof of successful execution in a live n8n instance.
